title: The Telangana (Transfer of pending cases of State of Telangana from the A.P.Administrative Tribunal to High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad) Act, 2016.
full_text: The Telangana (Transfer of pending cases of State of Telangana from the A.P.Administrative Tribunal to High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad) Act, 2016. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 2017-01-24 Act Year: 2017 Short Title: The Telangana (Transfer of pending cases of State of Telangana from the A.P.Administrative Tribunal to High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad) Act, 2016. Long Title: An Act to provide for the transfer of pending cases, before the Andhra Pradesh Administrative Tribunal to the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad pertaining to the State of Telangana consequent upon the Notification No.G.S.R.888(E), dated 15th September, 2016, issued by the Government of India.
